reuse.why: Introduces one exported isHoliday used by the existing isNonWorkingDay and by getDatesInRange, though app.ts could have reused isNonWorkingDay itself instead of keeping `d.isWeekend(date) || isHoliday(...)`.

duplication.why: The holiday-matching rule is defined once; only the pre-existing weekend-or-holiday expression in getDatesInRange remains a small parallel of isNonWorkingDay.

placement.why: The matching rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the other weekend/holiday helpers, and the server handler imports it.

scope.why: Only the holiday matcher, its two call sites and tests change.

maintainability.why: A small, named function that every holiday check goes through makes the MM-DD format easy to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Both holiday checks now go through isHoliday.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated by the diff; the previously inline includes() in app.ts is replaced by the shared isHoliday.
